description: Every scenario of docs/DESIGN.md section 16.3 that is feasible on a 16 GB, 8-core laptop with synthetic data. Runs in listed order; later runs reuse index files written by earlier ones.

config.description: Every scenario of docs/DESIGN.md section 16.3 that is feasible on a 16 GB, 8-core laptop with synthetic data. Runs in listed order; later runs reuse index files written by earlier ones.

not_run.reason: 6.1 GB of vectors plus the 6.1 GB generated input exceed what fits next to the OS in 15.4 GB RAM without paging.
Same memory limit as exact-n1000000-d1536 (input, exact ground-truth copy and index).
SIFT1M, GloVe-100 and the 384-d/1536-d embedding sets are downloads that DESIGN §16.2 requires the user to approve; they were not downloaded. tools/datasets/fetch.py and hdf5_to_npy.py prepare them.
Windows offers no supported way to evict the file cache without a reboot; all load timings are warm-cache.
Thread affinity is not implemented in vf_bench; the OS scheduler places threads.

The 12-configuration grid runs serial builds (graph statistics come from the single-threaded backend); at 1M rows this would take several hours. The 1M point is covered by scale-n1000000-* with a parallel build.
hnswlib/FAISS comparisons are optional (DESIGN §16.1) and were not installed.
